mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_id AS policyId, p.policy_name AS policyName, p.policy_summary AS policySummary, p.department_name AS departmentName, p.begin_date AS beginDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.bookmark_count AS bookmarkCount FROM policies p JOIN Untitled5 ui ON p.user_id = ui.user_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ( p.support_target LIKE CONCAT('%', (SELECT name FROM regions WHERE region_id = ui.region_id), '%') OR p.support_target LIKE '%전국%' ) ORDER BY p.end_date ASC
